O.content: The chart title reads "Top Product Lines: Ad Spend vs Sales".
The horizontal-axis inscription reads "Advertising Spend ($ thousands)".
Five blue circular marks are visibly labeled Line A, Line B, Line C, Line D, and Line E.
From Line A through Line E, the labeled marks are successively farther right and higher on the page.

O.location: visible chart text and plot area
O.content: No visible inscription or mark states a timeframe, profitability, ROI, margin, budget threshold, or that these five lines are the full product-line population.

B.text: If a broader budget approval or rejection requires evidence beyond the displayed ad-spend and sales positions, and the chart does not state that sales alone is the decision criterion or provide profitability, ROI, timeframe, or full-scope information, then the evidence-review option is the justified workflow choice.
B.conditions: Applies unless the task or a supplied policy explicitly authorizes a broader budget conclusion from this scatterplot alone.
